svg.text: AI Support Agent — customer deployment architecture (AWS)
Everything inside the orange boundary is owned by the customer. No component has a public IP or internet-facing listener.
Customer AWS account · us-east-1 (simulated customer environment)
Customer VPC 10.40.0.0/16 · 2 AZs · flow logs → CloudWatch
NAT only — nothing else is placed here,
no SSH key, no public IP
CPU autoscaling · auto-rollback on failed deploy
VPC endpoints — AWS APIs never leave the AWS network
Interface: ecr.api · ecr.dkr · logs · secretsmanager · ssm · ssmmessages · ec2messages
Gateway: S3 (policy: ECR image layers only) · DynamoDB (policy: tickets table only)
customer CIDRs ──▶ ALB :80/443 ──▶ tasks :8080 (tasks accept traffic from ALB SG only)
tasks egress: TCP 443 only (VPC endpoints + LLM API via NAT)
test client: no inbound rules; egress to VPC CIDR only
default security group: all rules removed
no ECS Exec / SSH into containers · no internet-facing load balancer
flow logs capture accepted + rejected traffic for audit
resource policy: ONLY the task role can read values
annual auto-rotation · encrypts secrets, table, logs, SNS, images
CMK encryption · point-in-time recovery · task role: PutItem only
immutable tags · scan on push · CMK · keeps last 30 images
Logs: app JSON + flow logs, 365 days, CMK
13 log metric filters (LLM errors, latency, tokens…)
12 alarms · dashboard · 5 saved Logs Insights queries
SSE · public access blocked · TLS-only policy · lifecycle
execution role: pull this image, write this log group
task role: read 2 secrets, PutItem on 1 table
github-deploy: OIDC, one repo + protected env
nobody human can read secret values
release: push image to ECR, register task definition, update ECS service (AWS control plane — never through the VPC)
